summary:
# NOTES: Elsie's Motherhood (Martha Finley, 1876; 5th Elsie book, sequel to Elsie's Womanhood)

Single book. Preface: story continues at request of readers; Ku Klux Klan included per Congressional Committee reports; 1867-68 setting.

## Core cast
- **Elsie Dinsmore Travilla** ("Elsie", "mamma", "my little wife" to husband). Married Edward Travilla 10 years ago; anniversary celebrated at Ion.
- **Edward (Ed'ard) Travilla**, husband, "Mars Ed'ard" to servants. Owner of Ion.
- **Horace Dinsmore**, Elsie's father, "papa"/"grandpa", lives at the Oaks. Wife **Rose** (Rosie's mother). Son **Horace Dinsmore Jr.** (brother of Elsie, "Brother Edward" is Travilla). Daughter **Rosie (Rosie/Rose)**.
- Children of Elsie & Edward: **Elsie** (little Elsie, 9→10, "namesake daughter", thoughtful, sweet), **Eddie** (Edward, impulsive, proud, wilful; shot father), **Violet "Vi"** (5, sleepwalker, fiery, lisp "'vite"), **Harold** (baby-talk, "Fank"/"dus"), **Herbert** (baby, nursery).
- Servants: **Aunt Chloe** (nurse, "mammy"), **Dinah** (nursery girl), **Aunt Dicey** (housekeeper/cook), **Aunt Sally** (quarter nurse, medicines), **Uncle Joe** (old, "Massa Edard"), **Solon** (coachman), **Ben** (Travilla's foster-brother, body servant), **Prilla**, **Jack**, **Minna**, **Tom**, **Pomp**, **Bungy** (watch dog), **Bruno** (Newfoundland, pet, guardian).
- Ponies: **Prince** (Eddie's), **Princess** (Elsie's), grey. **Beppo** Travilla's bay horse.
- Grandfather Dinsmore's household at Roselands (new house, old father Mr. Dinsmore lives there): daughters **Louise Conly** (widow, "Mrs. Conly") and **Enna Johnson** (widow, bitter, "Aunt Enna"). Louise's children: **Calhoun "Cal" Conly** (~21), **Virginia "Virginia"** (10, Ginny), **Isadore "Isadore"** (12), **Arthur Conly** (Art, bookish, Silverheels pony), **Walter "Wal" Conly** (2 years younger than Dick). Enna's children: **Dick Percival** (Richard, mischievous, older), **Molly Percival**, **Bob** and **Betty** (babies of 5 and 3). Rosie's sister? (Rosie is Horace's daughter.)
- Sophie (Carrington widow, Elsie's childhood friend, husband Mr. Carrington dead): children **Herbert Carrington**, **Meta Carrington** (prying), **Daisy Carrington** (ill, recovers), **Harry Carrington**, etc.; mother-in-law **Mrs. Carrington** (elder, "old lady"); nephew **George Boyd** (manages Ashlands, maimed right hand, Ku Klux, scalded).
- Lucy Ross (Adelaide Allison's relative/sister? — Adelaide Allison is Elsie's aunt "Aunt Addie"/Mrs. Allison); Lucy Ross's children: **Philip "Phil" Ross** (saucy), **Gertrude "Ger"** (blue eyes, 9), others. Governess **Miss Fisk**.
- **Mrs. Allison (Adelaide)** of Roselands/Oaks family, sister of Louise/Enna.
- **Pastor Mr. Wood** (Springbrook), wife **Mrs. Wood**; Mr. Wood married Travilla and Elsie.
- **Dr. Burton** (old physician, "Barton" once; family doctor). **Dr. Savage** (drunk, unskilled, Klan surgeon).
- **Mr. Leland** (northern, ex-Union officer, bought Fairview, carpet-bagger), wife **Mary Leland**, son **Archie** (Archie is kind, noble), daughter **Mary Leland**, younger children.
- **The Fosters** of Fairview: widow **Mrs. Foster**; son **Wilkins Foster** (hated Lelands, shot by Mrs. Leland/Archie, dies); daughters **Annie** and **Lucinda** (teachers).
- **Ronald Lilburn** ("Cousin Ronald", Scottish, ventriloquist, "Ah ha! um h'm!"; Elsie's maternal cousin from Edinburgh).
- **Martha/Martin Snell** (alias, detective "Martin"; gray eyes).
- **Jim Blake** (killed by Ku Klux? no: Blake killed in raid), **Jones** (stage driver shot), **Dr. Savage**, **Green** (drunk), **Bill Dobbs**, **Smith**, **Nick Ward** (gambler, broken nose), **Mr. Daly** (minister, wife, son **Frank Daly**), **Minerva** (quarter woman, arm hurt, baby Ben dies), **Uncle Mose** (dies, rheumatism, "Jordan"), **Aunt Delia**, **Uncle Jack**, **Lize**, **Hannah**, **Silvy** (quarter people).
- **Mrs. Murray** (Ashlands housekeeper, Scots).
- **Aunt Wealthy** (Lansdale, 80), **May** and **Harry** (Lansdale), babies.
- **Ku Klux**: "White Brotherhood", disguised with horned white gowns, red tongues (flannel), leather bag for water.

## Key events, in order
1. Anniversary (10 years) of Elsie & Edward's wedding; family party at Ion; Elsie wears wedding dress with veil, orange blossoms; renewal of vows by Mr. Wood.
2. Visits: Travilla and children drive to Oaks, Roselands, Ashlands, Pinegrove, Springbrook. Phil Ross runs out of school to see Elsie.
3. Ion party: Eddie asks Phil; banquet; children sent to bed at nine.
4. Ponies given; Vi and Harold promised rides. Quarter medicines (Aunt Sally). School for freed people; Sunday school. Vi and Elsie buy red flannel for Aunt Delia; Eddie buys tobacco for Uncle Jack.
5. Fairview (Mr. Leland) controversy; Foster family hatred. Eddie shoots father in grounds (Dick and Walter taunt/dare him; pistol). Ben sees; father falls; scalp wound; Dr. Burton attends. Eddie confesses; Mr. Dinsmore; father forgives.
6. Political debate at Ion: Boyd, Foster, Conly; Ku Klux defended by Boyd. Calhoun joins Klan (deceived by Foster and Boyd). Calhoun returns to Roselands; mother Louise and Enna sew disguises.
7. Dick and Walter steal key, find disguises. Ion evening: boys dress as ghosts, frighten children; Travilla whips Dick, Calhoun whips Walter. Disguises burned by grandfather.
8. Vi sleepwalks; stage driver Jones shot by Ku Klux; Vi witnesses; Bruno finds her; Vi dreams nothing; Ku Klux note on Leland gate.
9. Ion visit (Dinsmore carriage); Sophie's son Daisy ill; Boyd suspected of Klan.
10. Dick and Walter receive birthday ponies (Travilla and Elsie send ponies and forgiveness). Eddie buys whips for Dick and Walter; sends books to Dick/Walter and girls.
11. Raid on Ion's quarter; Leland's coffin threat ("ten days"); school-house burned; Minerva's baby dies (Ben); Uncle Mose dies; Leland shot, hidden at Ion.
12. Detective Martin/Snell; Travilla warned; ambush planned; Ku Klux driven off by Mr. Lilburn's ventriloquism and troop-bugle trick.
13. Boyd scalded by lye (Aunt Dicey and Uncle Joe); hidden at Rood's still-house; leaves for Texas; Boyd dies? (no; Boyd flees).
14. Wilkins Foster shot by Mrs. Leland, dies after repentance; funeral; Elsie helps Fosters' daughters teach.
15. Viamede trip (Louisiana); party includes Carringtons, Dinsmores, Daly family (Frank, Harold's friend), Lilburn, Aunt Wealthy, Harry Duncan.
16. Gambling-ship episode; Lilburn/ventriloquism exposes card cheat Nick Ward.
17. Meta pries into grandmother Elsie's play-room (Vi involved; broken china plate); punishment; Vi confesses to father and mother; Meta locked in room; Meta's key found.
18. Herbert nearly drowns at bridge; Bruno saves him; Uncle Joe. Eddie learns about courage and risk; Elsie speaks of heaven.

Ends mid-scene: Elsie and mother discuss heaven on Viamede veranda.

Note: "Grandma" is Elsie Grayson, first Elsie Dinsmore's mother (buried at Viamede), Horace's first wife; Horace's wedding to Elsie Grayson was secret in New Orleans, guardian angry, Elsie died, left daughter (Elsie Dinsmore).
